title: The last tree
logline: The last trunk before the glow, close, its bark in ink on warm paper, a hand on it at the page's edge. The sequence has one page left. The hand doesn't let go.

panels.composition: A single cedar trunk close, its bark in ink on paper warm-toned edge to edge, a man's hand resting on it at the page's edge, the light beyond the trunk too bright to hold detail.
